company.shortDescription: Avito is a classified advertisements platform that allows users to buy and sell used cars, clothes, real estate, and other accessories.
company.description:
Avito is a classified advertisements platform that allows users to buy and sell used cars, clothes, real estate, and other accessories. The Buyers and sellers use its line of business for the exchange of products and services such as coins, collectibles, computers, memorabilia, stamps, and toys, as well as concert and sporting tickets. 

Jonas Nordlanderr and Filip Engelbert founded Avito in 2007. Its headquarters is in Moscow in the Russian Federation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Secondary Market round raised $1,160,000,000, or 87.28% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,425,265 to $3,850,000,000, a 518.5x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 82 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
